name: debug-inspector
description: Visualize your own C/C++ data structures — threads, semaphores, mutexes, queues, linked lists, any struct collection — as live, sortable tables while debugging with GDB. Config-driven and read-only.

debugInspector.configPath.description: Path to the config file. Absolute paths are used as-is; a relative path is resolved against the workspace root.

enumDescriptions: General milestones plus warnings/errors: activate, refresh, selection, GDB access failures, and a per-refresh summary of GDB round-trips saved by the batching optimizations (default).

Everything: every prepared GDB access string + result, step-by-step traversal (e.g. how 'next' is resolved at each hop), and a per-section breakdown of the round-trips saved (blob batch / when-from-blob / bar-max-from-blob).
debugInspector.logLevel.description: Verbosity of the Debug Inspector Output channel ("Debug Inspector: Show Log").

debugInspector.debugTypes.description: Debug adapter types the tracker attaches to. Use 'cppdbg' for GDB.

debugInspector.maxHardwareWatchpoints.description: How many watchpoints may use hardware debug registers. Beyond this — and for any pointer-dereferencing expression (which GDB watches along its whole access path, using several registers) — new watchpoints are created as (slower) software watchpoints, so resuming doesn't fail with 'Couldn't insert hardware watchpoints: too many'. x86 has 4 registers but a single linked/grouped (->) watchpoint can consume several. Set higher for targets with more registers, or 0 to always use software.

debugInspector.arch.description: INITIAL default for the active architecture overlay. The panel's top-bar arch picker overrides this per workspace (the picker lists the arch labels found in the config and is hidden when there are none). A section/field containing a 'common' key OR a key matching the active arch is resolved to 'common' (if present) merged with that arch's block; other arch blocks are dropped. 'common' is optional and applies under every arch. Default 'common' = base only.
